additional_concerns: The referenced launch circular is unavailable; the supplied source establishes the route and cutover but does not resolve operational questions about attempted, incomplete, continued or multipart submissions.

node.d50a03d126c7018d3a9eef7e requires each assessed component to qualify independently as an application or submission; the source does not establish that every attachment or transmission is a separate submission.
The candidates rely on supplied classifications and dates; their formulas do not determine product coverage or the legally operative submission event.

The packet does not define when attempted, incomplete, continued, transmitted or received filings become submissions; component-level dating in node.d50a03d126c7018d3a9eef7e therefore needs an operational interpretation before use.

The component granularity in node.d50a03d126c7018d3a9eef7e is supported only where each assessed component independently constitutes an application or submission; the source does not impose a separate routing obligation on every constituent part.
The referenced dependency missing.4ad6b317ad4ade41b82f120a is unavailable, so any additional definitions or qualifications it contains cannot be checked.

All candidates implement a routing obligation supported by units d19f9ecf9fd26.u0.0 and d19f9ecf9fd26.u8.1528, but that obligation does not itself encode either selected descriptive timing claim; this omission is not positive evidence of contradiction.

A pre-cutover OUT_OF_SCOPE result establishes neither permission to use existing channels nor the existence or duration of a parallel run; the candidates do not implement the existing-channel acceptance described in unit d19f9ecf9fd26.u3.737.

For node.d50a03d126c7018d3a9eef7e, the source does not specify independent component dating or establish that transmission alone constitutes submission; treating every constituent part as a separately dated submission, or attempted transmission as completed submission, would introduce unsupported scope or compliance outcomes.

The other candidates also rely on supplied event dates and routing outcomes whose operational assessment is not implemented; the packet supplies no general rule resolving attempted, incomplete, continued or transmission-versus-receipt cases.

The packet lists missing dependency missing.4ad6b317ad4ade41b82f120a without its contents, so it cannot supply additional timing, completion, exception or component-classification rules; the quoted source nevertheless directly supports both selected descriptive claims.

node.d50a03d126c7018d3a9eef7e assesses each individual component, but the source does not define component boundaries or establish separate submission dates for parts of one filing; that granularity requires support before application.

All candidates implement the source-supported routing requirement effective 30 November 2024, but that requirement does not implement either the historical launch claim or the future system-integration claim.
node.d50a03d126c7018d3a9eef7e introduces individual-component assessment; the source does not specify how to divide a filing into components or assign separate submission dates to them.
The packet supplies no operational criteria for completed submission or the controlling date where transmission and receipt differ; candidate facts must not silently supply those rules.
The referenced earlier circular is not supplied, so any operational conditions dependent on it remain unverified.

All candidates implement the source-supported mandatory submission route from 30 November 2024, but none implements the separate permission to settle recurring annual fees through e-IP; exclusion of fee-only events is not a prohibition on that permission.

The source identifies the 8 July 2024 circular but does not establish that consulting it is necessary to apply this rule or that it contains relevant qualifications; the missing dependency identifier is not expressly mapped to that circular.

node.d50a03d126c7018d3a9eef7e assigns timing and compliance to individual components, whereas the source does not specify component-level timing or whether transmission alone constitutes submission; these operational assumptions need support before resolving split or incomplete filings.
claim.7d41b91fc47a13c8c49bf08b correctly states the announced extension, but its MUST metadata overstates the source's 'will extend' announcement as a mandatory duty imposed on the SFC.

node.d50a03d126c7018d3a9eef7e introduces individual submission components as the evaluation unit; the source does not specify decomposition of a filing or independent dates for its parts, so this is supported only where each assessed component independently qualifies as an application or submission.

The packet does not establish submission-timing or completion criteria for attempted, incomplete, continued or mixed-channel filings; candidate date and routing inputs must not silently introduce deadlines, receipt rules or completion requirements absent from the source.
The missing dependency has no supplied content or explicit mapping to the 8 July 2024 circular; neither additional exceptions nor their absence can be inferred from that dependency.

The ENTAILED routing check concerns the executable rule conditional on supplied classifications; it does not establish that product coverage, event selection or submission dates have been correctly determined.
A false temporal scope yields OUT_OF_SCOPE, which does not implement permission to use existing channels during the extended parallel run.

The obligation findings establish fidelity of the conditional routing rules given correctly supplied facts; they do not establish implementation of product classification, operative submission timing or completed submission.

For node.d50a03d126c7018d3a9eef7e, the source supports applying the rule to a component only when that component itself constitutes an application or submission; requiring every attachment or internal filing step to be separately submitted through e-IP would be an unsupported extra restriction.

The retained source does not specify whether transmission, receipt or another event fixes the submission date or establishes completed submission; treating mere attempted transmission as sufficient compliance would add an unsupported permission.
Footnote 1 identifies product categories but does not expressly resolve exhaustiveness; automatically excluding every unlisted product would add an unsupported scope restriction.

The packet identifies missing dependency missing.4ad6b317ad4ade41b82f120a without its contents; no exception or operational criterion can be inferred from that missing material, although the retained circular independently supports the selected routing obligation and category statement.
